versions.content: I f development error detection is enabled , the functions Dio_ReadPort , Dio_WritePort and Dio_ Masked WritePort shall check the “Port Id ” parameter to be valid within the current configuration. If the “Port Id ” parameter is invalid, the functions shall report the error code DIO_E_PARAM_INVALID_PORT_ID to the DET.
